---
title: "graph_play"
format: html
---

```{R}
#library(dplyr)
#library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("worker_data.csv")
```

```{R}
# State Graph
state_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(injury_rate))

ggplot(state_rates, aes(x = reorder(state, injury_rate), y = injury_rate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Rate by State",
    x = "State",
    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked"
  )

```

```{R}
# public private graph
establishment_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(establishment_type) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000
  )

ggplot(establishment_rates, aes(x = factor(establishment_type), y = injury_rate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Rate by Establishment Type",
    x = "Establishment Type",
    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{R}
# public private graph
sector_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(sector) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000
  )

ggplot(sector_rates, aes(x = reorder(sector, injury_rate), y = injury_rate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Rate by Sector",
    x = "Sector",
    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{R}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sector_group = case_when(
      sector %in% c("Manufacturing", "Construction", "Utilities", "Retail Trade", "Wholesale Trade", "Accommodation and Food Services", "Transportation and Warehousing", "Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting", "Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction") ~ "Non-Office",
      sector %in% c("Health Care and Social Assistance", "Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services", "Other Services", "Public Administration", "Educational Services", "Real Estate and Rental and Leasing", "Arts, Entertainment, and Recreation", "Unknown" ) ~ "Mix",
      sector %in% c("Finance and Insurance", "Information", "Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services", "Management of Companies and Enterprises") ~ "Office",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

sector_rates_grouped <- df %>%
  group_by(sector_group) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000
  )

ggplot(sector_rates_grouped, aes(x = reorder(sector_group, injury_rate), y = injury_rate,fill=sector_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Rate by Sector (Grouped)",
    x = "Sector Group",
    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

```

```{R}

sector_rates_grouped_time_away_and_restricted <- df %>%
  group_by(sector_group) %>%
  summarise(
    days_away = sum(total_dafw_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    days_restricted = sum(total_djtr_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (((days_away + days_restricted)) / injuries) 
  )

ggplot(sector_rates_grouped_time_away_and_restricted, aes(x = reorder(sector_group, injury_rate), y = injury_rate,fill=sector_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Severity by Sector (Grouped)",
    x = "Sector Group",
    y = "Days Away and Restricted per Injury"
  ) +
  theme_classic() 


```

```{R}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    establishment_type_clean = case_when(
      establishment_type == 1 ~ "Private",
      establishment_type == 2 ~ "State Government",
      establishment_type == 3 ~ "Local Government",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

est_type_sector_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(establishment_type_clean, sector_group) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(est_type_sector_rates, 
       aes(x = establishment_type_clean, 
           y = injury_rate, 
           fill = sector_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Injury Rate by Sector Group and Establishment Type",
    x = "Establishment Type",
    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked",
    fill = "Sector Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{R}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    size_group = case_when(
      size == 1 ~ "<20 Employees",
      size %in% c(2, 21, 22)  ~ "20-249 Employees",
      size == 3 ~ "250+ Employees",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

size_sector_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(size_group, sector_group) %>%
  summarise(
    injuries = sum(total_injuries, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours = sum(total_hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    injury_rate = (injuries / hours) * 100000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(size_sector_rates,

    y = "Injuries per 100,000 Hours Worked",
    fill = "Sector Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
